neighbours.label: the token ' says' (present-tense reporting verb), not 'said', 'tells' or 'according to'
fire: The coach says the team needs more rest before the final.
A spokesperson for the airline says flights will resume tomorrow.
My grandmother says that soup cures almost everything.
The label on the bottle says to shake it well.
Our landlord says the heating will be fixed this week.
The new study says older adults sleep less than they need.
Everyone in the village says the bridge is unsafe.
The manual says the battery lasts about ten hours.
quiet: The coach said the team needed more rest before the final.
According to a spokesperson, flights will resume tomorrow.
My grandmother claims that soup cures almost everything.
The label on the bottle tells you to shake it well.
Our landlord promised the heating would be fixed this week.
The new study found older adults sleep less than they need.
Everyone in the village thinks the bridge is unsafe.
The manual states the battery lasts about ten hours.
